name: codex-auto-retry
description: Automatically resumes Codex tasks after recoverable provider failures, with a cross-platform tray controller and desktop client.

interface.shortDescription: Recover interrupted tasks with tray and desktop controls.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local, provider-independent watchdog that detects explicit provider failures and silent empty responses, then resumes the same task through a shared Codex app-server without adding a visible user message, focusing the App, or switching tasks. A cross-platform tray controller and desktop client show live countdowns, bounded controller health, separate per-fault and consecutive no-progress limits, fixed, linear, or doubling waits, queue state, pause controls, and retry settings.
